query: SELECT s.id, s.createdAt, si.productId, p.name, si.quantity FROM sales s JOIN saleItems si ON s.id = si.saleId JOIN products p ON si.productId = p.id WHERE p.name = 'Dose Gin Dober' ORDER BY s.createdAt DESC
